nom: Drunk Elephant Kamili Cream Body Cleanser

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including winter-dry and year-round dry skin, report the cleanser leaves skin soft and hydrated without the tight or itchy feeling they get from soap or other body washes.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive, hyper-sensitive, or fragrance-allergic skin repeatedly say it does not sting, itch, or trigger reactions, though one sensitive-skin reviewer still found the bottle physically hard to squeeze.
segments.combination: One reviewer with oily patches says it cleans without stripping while helping balance those oilier areas.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers who mention dryness say the cleanser keeps skin hydrated and soft enough to skip lotion, with a couple noting they still follow up with a body cream or lotion for extra moisture.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with redness or eczema (including one describing her son's eczema) report calmer skin without the dry red patches they got from other cleansers; no reviewer reports increased redness.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers frame the low-pH, non-foaming formula as gentler on the skin barrier than typical soap, saying it avoids the stripped, squeaky-clean feeling; one reviewer warns it stings when used right after shaving legs.
concerns.spots: A few reviewers report the cleanser helped clear body and chest acne or breakouts within weeks; this is not a concern raised by most reviewers, so it appears to be an occasional rather than typical effect.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer notes it did not break out her skin and another reports it cleared existing breakouts, but most reviews do not address blemishes at all.
concerns.oiliness: Only one reviewer addresses oiliness directly, saying it helps balance oily spots while keeping the rest of her skin from drying out.
